claims.claim_text: The indexed Carlton R. Bulger is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact full name, middle initial, and private identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and exact normalized full name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated October 27, 1939; the index does not provide an OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: The occupation code in the Army record has no entry in the official numerical list and is not interpreted or published.

claims.temporal_assessment: The conflicting Army record cannot establish Theodore J. Bulinski's chronology, occupation, or employment.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Dwight H. Bulkley is a high-confidence match to the author of two December 1945 reports preserved in OSS Record Group 226.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A scholarly source cites two December 1945 reports by Dwight H. Bulkley in RG 226, and an official 1946 FRUS volume identifies the same rare full name in Bangkok.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact uncommon full name and middle initial, matching OSS record group, Bangkok context, and independent official postwar record support a high-confidence identity; no private identifier was used.
claims.temporal_assessment: The reports date to December 1945 and the diplomatic record to 1946. They confirm identity but do not document a pre-OSS employer or immediate predecessor.
claims.match_notes: No prewar Pomona or biographical claim is published from discovery-only alumni material. Box 92 remains necessary for pre-OSS chronology.
